study: zero-shot resolution invariance, checkpoint selection corrected (third and last of the three B2 materials -- point 7 is now complete across all six geometry x material cases)

training.patience_arithmetic: stopped at best_epoch + patience*validate_every exactly (1450 + 15*50 = 2200) -- unlike Neo-Hookean and Mooney-Rivlin, which both ran the full 4000-epoch budget without triggering patience 15, this is direct evidence patience 15 can fire on a real (not just theoretical) B2 curve. Patience 8 would have stopped by epoch 1800, which is before the actual best at 1450 -- so on this specific curve, patience 8 would have missed the best checkpoint too.

reading.headline: B2 x Arruda-Boyce works too, 0.0940 to 0.3402 across seven unseen meshes -- all three B2 materials now confirmed. Point 7's six-case resolution-invariance study is complete.
reading.arruda_boyce_is_the_weakest_B2_case: Arruda-Boyce is the worst of the three B2 materials at 6/7 meshes -- its errors are higher than both Neo-Hookean's and Mooney-Rivlin's at almost every point tested, not just on average.
reading.but_its_spread_is_narrower: Despite the higher baseline error, Arruda-Boyce's spread across the seven meshes is 3.62x -- narrower than both Mooney-Rivlin's 4.91x and Neo-Hookean's 3.78x. Being the least accurate B2 material and having the most even error across resolutions are not the same property, and this case separates them.
reading.the_early_stop_evidence: This is the first B2 fixed-selection run where patience 15 actually fired rather than the run reaching the epoch cap. The stop lands exactly at best_epoch + patience*validate_every, confirming the mechanism works as designed. It does not, on its own, answer whether patience 8 (what the three B1 zero-shot runs used) is too tight -- this run used patience 15 throughout -- but it is one more noisy, long-plateau-then-recover curve added to the record.
reading.all_three_B2_materials_exceed_B1's_worst: B1's worst-case spread across three materials is 2.11x. All three B2 materials exceed it: 3.78x, 4.91x, 3.62x. B2's resolution invariance is real for every material tried and weaker than B1's for every material tested.
